_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Stockholm C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). Pilot scope: the main-line station (tracks 1–19, the halls); Stockholm City and T-Centralen come later.

connections.note: OSM gap: the hall corridor stops 8 m short of platform 10.
OSM gap: the south ends of the northern platforms meet the hall's north side.
Assumed: stairs from the tunnel below to the 15/16 platform, like the other islands. OSM maps none here; no lift is assumed, so step-free routes to 15/16 are 'not mapped'.

sources.note: Jernhusen's station plan of Stockholm C, January 2026 (PDF supplied by the owner): which shop is in which unit, and the units' outlines, traced from the plan's pictures. Placed by fitting each picture to OpenStreetMap: Centralhallen to its shop pins (median 3.3 m off), Nedre hallen at the same scale onto the escalators it shares with Centralhallen, Övre hallen to its entrances, escalator and shops (median 2.7 m), Cityterminalen to its shop pins (median 5.1 m). Not ODbL: Jernhusen hasn't licensed the plan; see data/stations/README.md.
Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000001).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract) with 7 hand connections for gaps in OSM; see connections[].note.
Level names checked against Jernhusen's station plan (Centralhallen, Nedre hallen, Övre hallen).
Shops, cafés and restaurants from Jernhusen's January 2026 plan, with their outlines: 67 places (25 new), 6 OSM places that the plan no longer lists or that were on the wrong floor removed.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 31 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000001).
